title: Injectivity of concatenated chunk encodings
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $f,g$ assign a cell value to each natural number. If the words formed by concatenating the first $m$ encoded cell values of $f$ and $g$ are equal, then $f(j)=g(j)$ for every $j<m$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
